info.title: Z-API Omni - Webhook center
info.description: Query the event deliveries to your webhooks, resend deliveries, see each webhook's state and reactivate a suspended webhook. Every route uses the workspace Secret Key (the `Bearer` prefix is optional) and also exists without the `/v1` prefix. Any workspace role can use it; the `ENTERPRISE` plan is not required.

get.description: Lists the event deliveries to the webhooks of the Secret Key's workspace, newest first, with no total. Every filter is optional. Without `from` and `to`, the period is the last 24 hours. The list only shows what is within the plan's current retention.

parameters.name: webhookId
parameters.description: Only the deliveries of this webhook.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only the deliveries in this status. Any other value returns `400`.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Only the deliveries of this event type. Accepted in any letter case. Any other value returns `400` with `eventType invalido`.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Only the deliveries of this event (UUID, the same as the `x-webhook-event-id` header). Any other format returns `400`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period, in ISO-8601 UTC. It must be earlier than `to`. A `from` earlier than the plan's retention is moved to its start, with no error, and the response carries `fromAdjusted: true`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period, in ISO-8601 UTC.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Outside that range, `400`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page, unchanged. A value that does not decode returns `400`.

200.description: A page of deliveries. `nextCursor` is `null` on the last page.

400.description: Missing or invalid `Authorization` header, source IP outside the workspace allowlist, or an invalid filter.

post.description: Makes a new attempt of the delivery, with no request body. It goes to the webhook's **current** URL, authentication and secret, with the stored body and the same `X-Webhook-Event-Id` and `X-Webhook-Delivery-Id`. `X-Webhook-Attempt` is always greater than the previous attempt's. Limit: 1 resend per minute per delivery.

parameters.description: Delivery ID (UUID), taken from `deliveryId` in the delivery list. Any other format returns `400`.

post.description: Resends the `FAILED`, `NOT_SENT`, `EXPIRED` and `UNKNOWN` deliveries of a webhook's current failure episode: those whose last attempt is at or after the first failure of the sequence, including the ones that arrived later. Each request queues up to 1,000 deliveries. Repeat every 2 minutes while `remaining` is greater than zero, before `oldestExpiresAt`. There is no bulk resend by filter.

post.description: Reactivates a suspended webhook, with no request body: it clears the suspension and resets the failure sequence. The workspace Owner and Managers receive an email saying who reactivated it. A webhook that is not suspended returns `200` with its current state, with no effect. Retained events are not resent automatically: use the bulk resend.

200.description: Webhook state after the reactivation, with the same fields as an item of `GET /v1/webhooks/health`.

DeliveryStatus.description: `SUCCEEDED`: your server responded 2xx. `RETRYING`: it failed and will be retried at `nextAttemptAt`. `FAILED`: it failed and will not be retried. `NOT_SENT`: nothing was sent (webhook suspended or circuit open). `EXPIRED`: 23 hours passed without success. `UNKNOWN`: the next attempt should have happened more than 1 hour ago and there is no record of it. `RESENT`: resent less than 1 hour ago, waiting for the result.

Outcome.description: Result of an attempt: `SUCCEEDED` (2xx), `HTTP_ERROR` (your server responded with another status), `TIMEOUT` (no response within 5 s), `CONNECTION_ERROR` (connection, TLS or DNS error), `DESTINATION_REFUSED` (destination refused), `NOT_SENT_CIRCUIT_OPEN` and `NOT_SENT_SUSPENDED` (nothing sent) and `EXPIRED` (23 h window ended).

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID. It is the same as the `x-webhook-delivery-id` header.

eventId.description: Event ID. It is the same as the `x-webhook-event-id` header.

channelId.description: ID of the event's channel. `null` for account events.

lastHttpStatus.description: HTTP status of the last attempt. `null` when it got no response from your server (timeout, connection or DNS error): do not treat it as a required integer.

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next attempt goes out. Only with `status` `RETRYING`.

resendable.description: Whether the delivery can be resent now.

notResendableReason.description: Why the delivery cannot be resent now. `null` when it can.

notSentReason.description: Only with `status` `NOT_SENT`: `SUSPENDED` (webhook suspended) or `CIRCUIT_OPEN` (the destination stayed unavailable until the deadline).

resentAt.description: Only with `status` `RESENT`: when the resend was requested.

nextCursor.description: Send it in `cursor` for the next page. `null` on the last one.

fromAdjusted.description: `true` when the requested `from` was earlier than the plan's retention and was moved to its start.

attemptNumber.description: Attempt number. It is the value of the `x-webhook-attempt` header.

origin.description: `AUTOMATIC`: attempt from the retry schedule. `MANUAL_RESEND`: resend requested through the center. `SYSTEM`: record made by Z-API Omni itself.

resentBy.description: Who requested the resend. Only on `MANUAL_RESEND`.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status of the response. `null` when the attempt got no response.

latencyMs.description: Time to the response, in milliseconds.

errorClass.description: Error class, when there was no response.

url.description: URL called, masked: the segment after `/token/` appears as `{token}` and the value of each query parameter as `{masked}`.

requestHeaders.description: Headers sent. `Authorization`, `X-API-Key`, your custom header and `X-Webhook-Signature` appear as `***`.

requestBody.description: Body sent, stored up to the size limit.

requestBodyTruncated.description: `true` when the body exceeded the stored limit and was cut. That delivery cannot be resent.

responseBody.description: Your server's response, stored up to the size limit.

responseBodyTruncated.description: `true` when the response exceeded the stored limit and was cut.

bodyHidden.description: With the Secret Key, always `false`: the bodies are filled in.

attemptNumber.description: Attempt number of the resend. It is the `x-webhook-attempt` your server receives.

message.description: Only when the send confirmation was slow: the resend may have been sent, check the result in a few minutes.

episode.description: Always `current`: the webhook's current failure episode.

queued.description: Deliveries queued by this request (up to 1,000).

remaining.description: Deliveries of the episode still left. Request the next batch 2 minutes later. A delivery whose resend failed counts here again.

skippedTruncated.description: Deliveries skipped because the body was truncated.

skippedNotResendable.description: Deliveries skipped for another refusal reason.

dailyRemaining.description: How many resends still fit in this webhook's daily cap (50,000).

oldestExpiresAt.description: When the oldest retained deliveries leave the plan's retention. Whatever is not resent by then is lost.

channelId.description: The webhook's channel. `null` for the default and the global webhook.

state.description: `ACTIVE`: enabled, with no open failure notice. `FAILING`: a failure notice was already given or is pending; it also applies after the 3rd notice when there is no suspension, and the webhook keeps receiving deliveries. `SUSPENDED`: delivery was suspended after the 3rd notice. `DISABLED`: you disabled the webhook. `NO_HISTORY`: `CHATWOOT` format, with no history, notices or suspension.

consecutiveFailures.description: Consecutive failures in the current sequence.

failingSince.description: Start of the current failure sequence.

alertsGiven.description: Failure notices already given in the current sequence (0 to 3).

alertPending.description: `true` when a notice is pending delivery.

suspendedAt.description: When delivery was suspended. `null` when not suspended.

episodeStartedAt.description: Start of the current failure episode: the first failure of the sequence.

retainedSince.description: Start of the episode that led to the last suspension, stored on reactivation, for the bulk resend of retained deliveries.

retentionDays.description: Days of history retention on the current plan: 3 on `ENTERPRISE`, 1 on the others.

CentralError.description: Validation or business-rule error from the center. `type` and `details` come when there is a stable code, as in the resend `422`.

bearerAuth.description: Secret Key generated in the Z-API Omni Security panel
